procedure: Header strips rendered with pdfplumber page.crop(...).to_image(resolution=300); ambiguous cells zoomed at 600 dpi. Labels read left-to-right per page.
structure_note: Column-split pagination, unlike Union's row-block scheme: p2+p3+p4 are one table (23 precincts + TOTAL) whose rows (all federal/statewide/judicial races) sit entirely on those three pages; p5+p6 repeat columns 1-22 for the LOCAL-races table (County Court Judge etc.). p4 is a narrow 2-column page (Porters Chapel + TOTAL); its data lines carry only 2 numeric tokens so extract_table_page's default find_table_top thresholds must retry with min_columns=2 for this page to parse. Total check: Colom 2992 (p2) + 5260 (p3) + 324 (p4) = 8576 = printed TOTAL.
truncation_note: Medgar Foundation, Eagle Lake Methodist, International Paper are page-edge truncations in the 2026 general recap; full names taken from the same county's 2026 primary precinct file (20260310__ms__primary__warren__precinct.csv), whose printed names match every truncated prefix. Yokena verified by 600 dpi zoom (matches the 2024 general spelling as well); 'Life' is complete (narrow column).
local_note: p5/p6 carry only local-office rows (County Court Judge, etc.), which are out of scope per the no-local-offices convention; they are recorded for completeness. Some local cells print 'X' (non-numeric).
